meta.title: Kisumu County Statistical Abstract 2024: tables by sub-county and ward (held until its page exists)
meta.scope: Kisumu County (042): every row and column of the KNBS Kisumu County Statistical Abstract 2024 tables whose layout parses cleanly, with sub-county sum checks. Excluded tables and reasons: docs/research/kisumu-handover-2026-11-28/abstract-dispositions-kisumu-2024.md.
meta.rule: Values as printed, each with source, period, unit, confidence, table, row, column and PDF page. Machine-parsed from the PDF text layer with structural checks (every data line parsed, one cell per column) and a sum check of sub-county rows against the printed Total; sampled tables checked against the page image. ".." (not available) cells are not entered. Every value is provisional until a reviewer approves it.
